claim: Intel's fiscal 2025 report put diluted EPS at -$0.06, with revenue of $59 billion.
summary: Intel's FY2025 results would have been released after the knowledge cutoff of 2026-01-04 (typically late January 2026). With no tools and no pre-cutoff data available for FY2025, neither the diluted EPS nor the revenue figure can be verified.
